This chapter does three things: it reviews what is established and what
is honestly incomplete, it lays out the program's agenda — a deliberate
redirect away from architecture-driven iteration, adopted once the
dictionary program ran to completion and closed
(@sec-dictionary-ablation, @sec-singonly-universality) — and it closes
with an engineering review of the implementation as read end-to-end,
including one live bug found (and confirmed) during figure generation.

## Where the program stands

**Established — multi-seed, checked in:**

- **The kernel-basis query decoder repairs the proved ceiling.** The
  moment decoder's $m \le 2$ angular nullspace is proved and removed;
  three seeds, reference bank, ID 0.4503 $\to$ 0.0399 (11.3$\times$)
  (@sec-kernel-decoder).
- **The dictionary question is closed**, after an arc that
  survived two of its own wrong hypotheses (@sec-dictionary-selection,
  @sec-dictionary-ablation): *the dictionary carries the singularity;
  conditioning carries the smoothness; nonlinearity needs a smooth
  basis.* In drive-linear operation, one exact singular member plus
  operator-conditioned coefficients is best-in-class on 2D Laplace,
  screened Laplace, and 3D Laplace alike; in nonlinear field mode the
  polynomial members are load-bearing; MLP members are prunable
  everywhere.
- **Dimensional genericity, end to end.** The same architecture at a
  bitwise-identical parameter count trains in 3D with zero core changes,
  and 3D singular-only beats the double-layer oracle 2$\times$ on the
  multiply connected shell tier with tight seed variance
  (@sec-3d-meshtransformer, @sec-dictionary-3d).
- **The nonlinear wall break.** The zero-preserving-nonlinear field mode
  leaves the drive-linear regime on Liouville — 0.77 $\to$ 0.46 ID with
  no seed overlap against the superposition wall (@sec-liouville).
- **The discipline earned its keep.** Pre-registration, multi-seed
  replication, and dated ledgers caught at least three would-be wrong
  conclusions: the single-seed Liouville MLP verdicts (both directions),
  the span hypothesis (killed by its own pre-registered test), and the
  3D "MLPs help" reading (an artifact of polynomial-member harm).
- **The mainstream baseline is steel-manned, and beaten in both
  regimes.** Transolver, at matched and native capacity, streaming and
  dataset-backed (its own published regime): 20$\times$ / 7.7$\times$
  at matched budget respectively, with two of the gaps — drive-spectrum
  extrapolation and exact equivariance — not closing at any budget
  tested (@sec-transolver, @sec-transolver-dataset). The earlier
  external rows (GLOBE, radius-free GeoTransolver) were deliberately
  under-optimized controls at 1,000 updates and are superseded as
  evidence.
- **The cost curves are measured, the scaling wall was named — and is
  now measured closed.** The cost law is the designed dense $O(QS)$
  ($R^2$ = 0.999), the encoder is not the wall, and inference fits one
  A100 at the product scope ($\sim 10^5$ boundary elements $\times$
  $10^6$ queries). Training memory — $\approx$742 GiB retained-graph
  extrapolated on the A100 fit, OOM on a 189 GB GB200 at the measured
  corners — is closed by the exact checkpointing fix: the near-product
  corner trains in **71.4 GiB** at $\approx$1.9$\times$ step time, with
  bitwise-unchanged outputs and gradients (@sec-scale-ckpt,
  @sec-decoder-role; paired archive
  `scale_checkpoint_paired_2026-07-05.json`).
- **Where attention earns its keep is settled in both directions.** The
  encoder-stress suites exist with results (@sec-encoder-stress,
  @sec-single-layer); the encoder-depth null is confirmed on the
  all-Dirichlet family at two seeds (@sec-encoder-depth); and the
  mixed-BC discriminator shows where attention is genuinely
  load-bearing — enc0 is unreliable on the mixed shell while one
  encoder layer matches two (@sec-mixed-bc).
- **The vector channels are measured, and they stay.** Not load-bearing
  on 2D Laplace (matched accuracy at 60% fewer parameters);
  load-bearing on screened and 3D in-distribution splits; the
  capacity-matched wide-scalar control did not recover the gap, so it
  is oriented transport, not width (@sec-scalar-only).
- **The parity contract: measured, diagnosed, lifted, composed.** The
  first pseudoscalar-target benchmark met the type system's predicted
  no-response; the diagnosis was one line of group theory; the $0o$
  extension lifted it exactly as pre-registered (circulation 0.647
  $\to$ 0.037 at five seeds, the whole velocity field
  $\sim$5$\times$ better), and on the first multi-field suite the
  parity and nonlinearity mechanisms *compose* (@sec-fluid-suites,
  @sec-pseudo-extension, @sec-euler-bernoulli).
- **The scale gauge is intrinsic *by default*, and equivariance is
  unconditional on that path.** The reference length is derived from
  the geometry (radius of gyration), accuracy-neutral at three seeds,
  with the convention-drift demonstration on record: a 3$\times$
  corrupted external gauge costs the explicit-key model 4.64$\times$
  while the intrinsic model is bitwise immune
  (@sec-intrinsic-gauge). **Scoped honestly since 2026-07-22:** the
  industrial campaign ran on the *explicit override* with a
  hard-coded constant, and paid for it — every fixed-gauge checkpoint
  diverged on cross-family zero-shot transfer. The default's guarantee
  was never wrong; it was simply not the path in production. **The
  repair was then built, calibrated, and tested — and it failed**
  (@sec-drivaerml-transferv2): retraining under the intrinsic gauge
  leaves every seed diverging cross-family, so the gauge was not the
  mechanism. The unconditional-equivariance claim on the default path
  stands; the inference that fixing the gauge would fix transfer does
  not.
- **One full-width head.** Heads at fixed score capacity are
  bookkeeping; the single full-width head won decisively on 2D Laplace
  and confirmed non-inferior on all 13 suite-split cells cross-suite,
  flipping the reference configuration on parsimony
  (@sec-heads-vs-rank, @sec-one-head-cross-suite).
- **The far-field ladder is closed at five seeds.** Strong inference
  (three rivals, pre-registered discriminators), an instructive
  refutation (the gate collapse was load-bearing), exclusion by
  construction, then licensed exact decay structure: 0.694 $\to$ 0.090
  at an unchanged training annulus — coverage mitigates, structure
  fixes (@sec-farfield-ladder).
- **A genuinely rotational Euler family exists, with exact labels.**
  Helmholtz/Bessel streamfunctions with fp64 certification against the
  steady momentum equation, couplings kept below the first Dirichlet
  eigenvalue — and the pressure parity wall's third instance, pinned at
  exactly 1.0 as pre-registered (@sec-euler-rotational).
- **The nonlinear-fragility ladder is closed, and the degree is now
  declared.** One engine behind both nonlinear extrapolation blowups —
  the multiplicative read-in's implicit drive degree $\sim$21 against
  targets of degree 1 and 2; the fix mirrors how linearity is declared:
  `field_mode="quadratic"` makes the output an exact degree-$\le 2$
  polynomial in the drive for any weights (structural test at
  $10^{-15}$), turning near-eigenvalue detonations of
  $10^{6}$–$10^{13}$ into 0.67 and closing the EB amplitude axis at
  0.086 when composed with parity (@sec-nonlinear-fragility).
- **The first solver-labeled nonlinear suite exists, with a measured
  label credential.** Steady incompressible Navier–Stokes on the bank's
  stars (Taylor–Hood P2–P1, analytic-Jacobian Newton; MMS orders
  2.92/1.90, velocity 5.9e-7 at production resolution, Newton
  grid-verified through Re 400, 4 rejected attempts in 1,400 cases,
  noise floors reported per split) — and the first *graded* structural
  wall: the linear arm's pressure gap to the nonlinear arms grows
  from zero (within seed noise) in the genuinely-Stokes band to
  $\approx 0.5$ at Re 300 once iteration 37's low-Re slice completes
  the curve. Its velocity gap stayed flat at $\approx 0.18$ across
  the *entire* Re 0.5–300 band — first read as a linear-read-in
  deficit, then revised by iteration 38's pre-registered confound
  check: a linear arm carrying the nonlinear arm's pseudo sector
  closes the Stokes-band velocity gap entirely (bottom bin $-0.024$),
  leaving a graded 0-to-0.1 velocity wall that tracks Re just as the
  pressure wall does — the flat gap was the missing parity sector,
  not the read-in class (@sec-ns-lowre). The
  declared-degree arm keeps pace with the unbounded nonlinear arm
  (0.278 ± 0.060 vs 0.231 ± 0.005 combined ID) without the stability
  premium it enjoyed on exact families, and Transolver's first
  measurement on the suite lands at 0.95 (@sec-ns-cavity).

- **Hard geometry needs the second exact member.** On the multiply
  connected multi-body family the single-layer member sweeps every
  split-seed comparison and, without it, the model loses to the
  pair-kernel control; on the simply connected deep cavity it helps
  too — at an honest extrapolation cost on easy geometry
  (@sec-single-layer, @sec-encoder-stress).
- **The stream factorization is priced.** Two-stream wins linear ID by
  3.6$\times$ the seed spread at matched parameters and is the only arm
  with roundoff-exact contracts; the motivating belief that structural
  drive-linearity buys spectrum extrapolation was falsified; and the
  zero-point misspecification lesson — a contract can be exactly
  enforced and exactly wrong — is on record
  (@sec-stream-factorization).
- **The GeoTransolver gap is decomposed, and the trace defect is fixed
  in structure.** The 40$\times$ DrivAerML-surface gap ran its
  pre-registered discriminators (@sec-nb-geot-gap,
  @sec-nb-geot-gap-verdict): uniform per-field losses killed H-A/H-E; a
  one-case overfit bounded the raw expressivity cap at $\sim$2$\times$;
  and the sharpest finding verified H-D numerically — the exact double
  layer evaluated AT a query on its own panel returns the **interior**
  jump branch ($-1/2$) while surface data are the **exterior** trace
  ($+1/2$ at $+\epsilon$), a sign flip under infinitesimal displacement
  that no learned coefficient can repair. H-C (representational
  generalization efficiency) owns the numeric balance; H-D is *why* the
  representation is inefficient at the trace. The constructive
  consequence is implemented to core standard: the declared
  **boundary-trace mode** (`trace_of`) side-corrects the own-panel
  double-layer entries to the exact exterior one-sided limit (the single
  layer is continuous and needs none) and gives each query typed
  read-outs of its own cell's encoded state — jump relation pinned on
  the analytic circle/sphere case to roundoff, equivariance/linearity/
  zero-preservation/chunking contracts tested, bitwise-off default, and
  a matched-protocol recipe arm
  (`mesh_transformer_surface_trace`, one declared delta by test)
  (@sec-decoder-role).

**Honestly incomplete:**

- **Strong-form residuals on the original suites.** Still high for the
  generalist (0.5–3.0 across Laplace, screened, and Liouville):
  $L^2$-fit training fits fields without satisfying operators. Now
  *reported* first-class — every driver emits a per-split fidelity
  block and the tables carry the column (@sec-fidelity-columns) — but
  the residuals themselves remain the open problem; neither the
  declared-degree mode nor the fidelity work changed them. The
  Navier–Stokes driver emits the block since iteration 37
  (strong-form momentum residual of the prediction with $\tilde\nu$
  read from the case, instrument-certified against the exact
  Kovasznay solution; @sec-ns-lowre), so the solver-labeled port is
  no longer open.
- **Rotational-Euler pressure under amplification.** The declared-degree
  arm holds near eigenvalues (velocity 0.216) but the $A^2$-amplified
  pressure sits at 0.686 — an accuracy-under-amplification question,
  not a stability one (@sec-nonlinear-fragility).
- **The far-field per-seed tail.** The ladder closed at the mean
  ($< 0.10$) with two of five seeds above the bar; the $r^{-1}$ member
  tails still reach $r^{-2}$ through fitted zero-circulation
  cancellation (@sec-farfield-ladder). Low priority.
- **Solver-labeled RANS (and 3D/higher-Re N-S) remain the next ledge**
  after iteration 36's steady 2D Navier–Stokes suite (@sec-ns-cavity):
  turbulence closures, boundary-layer-resolving meshes with a fresh
  noise-floor measurement, and unsteady statistics are all unpaid
  (live item 1 of the agenda below).
- ~~Product-scale training is gated on a memory fix~~ — **paid**:
  chunked decode closed the memory wall, and the subsequent decode
  profiling campaign made every step 7–14× faster besides.
- ~~The trace-mode acceptance experiment is unpaid~~ — **run and
  verdicted** (@sec-nb-trace-verdict): 2.03×, the ≥5× acceptance
  refuted but the 0.10 plateau broken; the full ledger continuation
  (batch → depth → composition → scale) lives in
  @sec-drivaerml-results. **The trace factorial then completed the
  attribution** (@sec-nb-trace-factorial-verdict): 3.8× total at
  flagship capacity — the dominant industrial mechanism — with the
  jump correction and the trace readouts near-perfect substitutes
  (either alone recovers ~96%; both add ~6%). The load-bearing
  information is boundary self-identification, and preserving at
  least one channel for it is a hard design constraint on every
  future variant (the exact correction is the zero-parameter
  principled choice).
- ~~The ×4-scale rung is unread~~ — **read, and the scale law with
  it** (@sec-nb-scalelaw-verdict). The rung trains at its
  stability-required LR/4 and finishes at 0.0123 — worse than ×2
  despite 4× the parameters (pure width bends under the μP-style
  LR ∝ 1/width constraint) — while the LR-stable rungs fit
  val ≈ 0.0125·$P_{\mathrm{M}}^{-0.32}$ with no bend through 4.8M.
  At GeoTransolver's ~9.5M budget the gap is now **measured: 2.34×
  at matched parameters** (×2L8 landed at 0.005828, inside its
  pre-registered band, @sec-nb-x2l8-verdict) — and the newest
  doubling's local slope flattened to 0.27 (from 0.42), a mild bend
  that pushes parity-by-scaling to ~134M (global slope) or ~230M
  (if the bend persists). **The pure-scaling ladder is closed at
  ×2L8.** The next factor of 2 is assigned to the
  parameter-efficiency route — the separable far-field decode
  (registered after the resolution probe, @sec-nb-sr-verdict) and
  attention structure now carry that mandate outright.
- **GeoTransolver's epoch-efficiency edge is unexplained.** Local
  shortcuts (corrector probes: triple null, no-go), optimizer
  (config-identical), supervision density (moderate), iteration count
  (falsified at matched params), and now raw scale (carries the
  *floor*, not the ep-1 point) are all excluded or accounted; the
  per-query-token diagnostic (E2) remains gated. The scale law
  sharpened the stakes rather than mooting them: scale pays on a
  clean-but-bending frontier, but GeoTransolver keeps a measured
  2.34× matched-parameter advantage (@sec-nb-x2l8-verdict), so
  whatever mechanism buys
  its per-parameter efficiency is still unnamed. What remains
  untested: the learned soft-slice global exchange itself. (The
  kernel factorial answered the adjacent attribution question from
  our side — see the next entry: at this rung the exact members
  carry little of our ID performance.)
- **The kernel factorial: run — falsifier fired, demotion applied**
  (@sec-nb-factorial-verdict-industrial, @sec-drivaerml-factorial).
  MLP-only reaches 1.084× the flagship (prediction was ≥1.25×;
  overlapping seed bands), so the industrial ID gains are not
  attributable to the exact singular kernels; the industrial claim
  is demoted to "boundary-integral-inspired" while the synthetic
  causation stands. Surviving structure: exact-only > MLP-only on
  every paired seed (~7%) and exact-only ≈ flagship — the eight
  learned members are evidence-orphaned at this rung. Both gated
  follow-ups have since resolved (@sec-nb-rider-verdict): (ii) the
  zero-shot OOD rider's falsifier fired — degradation ratios are
  indistinguishable between the arms (1.11–1.14× vs 1.11–1.13×), so
  **the demotion is total** and the #55 far-field design must not
  assume exact-kernel primacy (its case rests on O(N) cost and the
  self-identification constraint above); (i) the parsimony swap was
  NOT adopted — an exploratory ×2L8 reading (members removed costs
  ~9% at 9.6M, single seed vs ±12% rung spread) leaves the default
  configuration members-on.
- **GeoTransolver-on-OOD differential is provisional at deep-S1 on
  vector WSS** (@sec-nb-seal-verdict, @sec-program-review). Five seeds
  per model give disjoint degradation-ratio ranges (ours 1.072–1.113
  versus 1.126–1.136), but the published rank-sum calculation discards
  the matched-seed structure, the metric record is contradictory, and
  GeoTransolver's absolute WSS error is 2.5–2.7× lower. Pressure is
  suggestive only; S2 and zero-shot depth show no differential.
- **Cross-family transfer: the falsifier fired maximally, and the
  mechanism is a protocol flaw** (@sec-drivaerml-crossfamily,
  @sec-nb-crossfam-verdict). The stronger test — DrivAerML-trained
  checkpoints evaluated zero-shot on the SHIFT-SUV family — returned
  its worst branch: every MeshTransformer checkpoint (two capacities,
  three seeds) diverged to non-physical output while GeoTransolver
  stayed structured at 0.677 through the identical frozen pipeline.
  **The generalization identity failed its decisive zero-shot test as
  deployed.** A monotone but test-set-touching dose-response initially
  implicated the fixed declared scale gauge; the intrinsic-gauge repair
  was built, calibrated ($C=26.4766$), and **tested — it failed**
  (@sec-drivaerml-transferv2). The audit then found that the loader used
  for the supposedly train-only calibration included the held-out
  cases.
  Retrained under the intrinsic gauge, all four gate-0-passing seeds
  still diverge zero-shot (5.97 × 10³ to 1.90 × 10¹³ against
  GeoTransolver's 0.677); gate 1 fails and gate 2 is moot. **The gauge
  was a lever that moved the magnitude, not the cause.** Odds, revised
  on evidence: "transfers at all, post-repair" was ~75% and is now
  measured false at the structural gate; cross-family *advantage*
  35% → **< 5%**. Two exploratory side findings outlast the verdict:
  one of five intrinsic-gauge seeds reached a worse training basin
  (far too little evidence to estimate a 20% population risk), and
  that seed transferred *best* by two orders of magnitude — suggesting
  a possible tension between in-family fit and cross-family robustness
  that would need a separate, prospectively designed study.
- **True (full-mesh) OOD drag coefficients: blocked on research, not
  wiring.** The OOD verdict's drag numbers are subsample-integrated
  pseudo-coefficients; the upstream force/moment ground truth is
  fetched (139/139). The full-resolution gate sample showed the real
  obstacle: at 17.7M query cells / 50k sources the flagship's
  relative L2 is ~100 — the source-count/resolution transfer problem
  (the sr thread's axis, #55's domain). Pseudo-coefficients stay
  until that thread lands.
- **The effective-batch mechanism is identified**
  (@sec-nb-b22-verdict): matching optimizer-update count at large
  batch (16-GPU × 2000 ep) recovers only ~11% of the small-batch
  advantage — it is the gradient noise itself, not step count.
  Multi-node remains for inference and production retrains, now as
  a mechanism rather than an observation.
- **Barnes–Hut decode (#41): demoted to asymptotic.** Design complete,
  cluster_tree adversarially reviewed clean (182 tests); after the
  14× constant-factor win it gates only meshes well beyond current
  protocol sizes.

## The redirected agenda

The redirect, stated plainly: **no training-protocol tuning** — LR
decay, checkpoint policies, and schedule sweeps are protocol hygiene,
not research. The agenda was (a) benchmarks that stress-test the
architectural claims, (b) component-level evals, and (c) simplification
as the chief lens, plus one fair-ground comparison against the
strongest mainstream baseline. Most of its original directions have
since completed; their outcomes live in the ledger above and their
numbers in @sec-benchmarks.

**Item zero is now representation consistency.** Transfer-v2 ran and
failed its structural gate, so more gauge or optimizer arms cannot
rehabilitate the industrial identity. Before retraining, repair the
train/validation split, checkpoint/scheduler semantics, effective-weight
plumbing, and run manifest. Then compare the current cyclic contiguous-block
against a deterministic, nested, full-cover hierarchy at matched compute.
The decisive measurement is convergence of the represented surface
operator and its field pattern across levels, not another amplitude-only
validation score. The exact protocol and stop rules are in
@sec-program-review.

What else remains live:

1. **Solver-labeled Euler and RANS suites** — the next ledge: fields no
   longer analytically manufactured, the FEM catalog of
   @sec-transolver-dataset as the label pipeline, and the
   operator-fidelity columns no longer optional (@sec-part-ns holds the
   first rung, Navier–Stokes).
2. **Hierarchical decode backend — parked.** It is a possible speed
   lever, not a memory necessity, but the current Morton/AABB
   Barnes--Hut implementation has no measured dense crossover and
   introduces percent-to-tens-of-percent rotation dependence. Reopen
   only after the representation experiment establishes a real
   wall-clock need and a hierarchy can meet an explicit rotation-error
   contract (@sec-program-review).
3. **Strong-form residuals on the original suites** — the open problem
   behind the fidelity columns: $L^2$-fit training fits fields, not
   operators (@sec-fidelity-columns).
4. **Rotational-Euler pressure under amplification** — 0.686 near
   eigenvalues against velocity's 0.216: accuracy under
   150–6,000$\times$ target amplification, not stability
   (@sec-nonlinear-fragility).
5. **The affine zero-point knob** — a problem-declared homogeneous
   solution with the network predicting the deviation, for problems
   like Liouville where zero-preservation pins the wrong value;
   Armijo bar: beat the free single-stream control's Liouville score
   (@sec-stream-factorization).
6. **Degree-grading for drive-amplitude extrapolation** — moderate
   priority; after the composition result it promises a one-split gain
   (@sec-euler-bernoulli).
7. **The far-field per-seed tail** — close $< 0.10$ on every seed; the
   $r^{-1}$ member tails still reach $r^{-2}$ through fitted
   zero-circulation cancellation; low priority (@sec-farfield-ladder).
8. **Encoder-stress coverage** — more seeds and harder dials on the
   multi-body and deep-cavity families (@sec-encoder-stress).

**Parked, with reasons.** The mixed-BC/Green-representation learned
solve (shells with mixed Cauchy data) is parked, not abandoned — it
returns with the BC-diversity gap, on which a first installment is now
paid: the attention-necessity discriminator ran on the
mixed shell tier through the generalist arms (@sec-mixed-bc); the
specialist mixed-trace solve itself stays parked, and its 2D lessons
(orientation gauge, shared relaxation, exact patch quadrature) are
recorded in @sec-learned-bie. The solver-regime analysis of basis singularities (the
Yukawa low-$\tilde\kappa$ blowup) is parked with the specialist line it
belongs to. Asymmetric regularization of smooth members is moot:
the dictionary ablations answered member selection by pruning
(@sec-dictionary-ablation). Harmonic dictionary members are moot in
linear mode — the exact singular member *is* the harmonic structure —
and the operator-fidelity question they targeted moves to the
strong-form-residual live item of the agenda.
LR decay and checkpoint policy are protocol hygiene, not research; the
single would-be exception, the **nonlinear discriminator** (rerun
nonlinear singular-only under cosine decay — if it rescues to
$\sim$0.46, the polynomial members were an optimization crutch; if not,
they are representational), is parked here with them rather than
queued: it becomes worth running when the nonlinear line resumes
(@sec-singonly-universality). Finally, the **drive-depth sweep** that
would sharpen the mixed-BC attention claim — the genuinely nonlocal
*data* coupling lives in the drive blocks, held at one layer in every
iteration-19 arm — is parked unless a sharper claim is needed
(@sec-mixed-bc).

## The emerging architecture

*(The current best synthesis, not a final claim; every clause cites its
measurement and carries its caveat.)* The component evidence composes
into one candidate model:

> **lift $\to$ one encoder layer, one full-width head $\to$ conditioned
> two-exact-member singular decode** — roughly 82k parameters — covers
> everything measured so far.

This configuration is stated canonically, piece by piece with its
settings, in the architecture chapter's reference-configuration table
(@sec-reference-config); this section records the evidence trail behind
each clause. The *second* encoder layer is prunable everywhere
measured, including the mixed-BC tier where attention itself is
load-bearing (@sec-mixed-bc); *all smooth dictionary members* are
prunable in drive-linear operation, with the polynomial members
returning only in nonlinear field mode (@sec-dictionary-ablation,
@sec-singonly-universality); the *vector channels* are prunable on easy
2D geometry but are genuine oriented-transport capacity on 3D and
screened problems, so they stay (@sec-scalar-only); the
*single-layer member* is load-bearing on hard geometry — multiply
connected or deep-cavity — at an honest extrapolation cost on easy
geometry (@sec-single-layer); and the *head count* collapses to one
full-width head at matched total score capacity — decisively better on
2D Laplace ID, nowhere decisively worse across screened, fluid-velocity,
and 3D suites, with fewer parameters (@sec-heads-vs-rank,
@sec-one-head-cross-suite). The synthesis also has
**measured cost curves and a named path to product scale**: decode
$O(Q^{0.97}S^{0.96})$, inference within one A100 at the product scope
today, and product-scale training gated on checkpointing or a
hierarchical backend (@sec-scale). The caveats that keep this a
synthesis rather than a conclusion: one mixed tier, two-to-three seeds
on the newest results, drive depth unswept, product-scope costs
extrapolated rather than measured, and no encoder-stress benchmark yet
where even one attention layer fails.

## Engineering review

Findings from reading the sources end-to-end while writing this book. None
are speculative; each was verified in the code or by execution.

**A live, flagged footgun: concurrent recipe jobs race on the shared
`dataset_paths.yaml`.** Every launch script in the campaign fleet points
the recipe at its dataset by `sed`-ing one shared file; two concurrent
jobs needing *different* datasets race, and the loser silently evaluates
or trains on the winner's data. This is not hypothetical: the first
deep-OOD evaluation pass ran six jobs concurrently and the S1 lanes
silently evaluated S2's held-out set — caught only by per-row run-ID
provenance, purged, and rerun (@sec-nb-ood-deep-verdict). A durable fix
(job-local recipe copy, or a code-level dataset-path override) is a
**blocking precondition** for any future multi-dataset wave; until then,
jobs against different datasets must be serialized by hand.

**A found-and-fixed bug: the 3D star tier used to hang.**
As originally written, `build_laplace3d_sample(tier="star")` never returned:
its interior-query rejection bound used `max_star += abs(amplitude) * 35.0`
per mode — but 35 is the *coefficient* of the leading term of the $(4,0)$
harmonic, not its maximum on the sphere (which is 8; most table entries are
$\le 2$), so the acceptance window `hi_factor = 1.0 - 0.08 - max_star` went
negative and the rejection loop spun forever. The bug was caught during the
book's own figure generation (the gallery could not sample star-tier
queries) and fixed by replacing the analytic bound with the **sampled
surface's actual radial extrema** — exact for the mesh by construction; the
star tier now builds in milliseconds and all 3D results in @sec-benchmarks
postdate the fix. The residual lesson stands: `laplace3d.py` gained coverage
only after the incident, and a loose analytic bound in a rejection sampler
fails *silently* as an infinite loop rather than loudly as an error —
per-surface empirical bounds are the robust default.

**Duplication: the panel-influence math exists four times.** The
subtended-angle singular integral and the entire-order antiderivatives are
implemented in `layer_potential.py` (`double_layer_influence`),
`HarmonicPanelBIE._influence`, `NeumannHarmonicPanelBIE._influence`, and
`screened_laplace.harmonic_panel_influence` (whose docstring itself says
"functional twin of `HarmonicPanelBIE._influence`"). This was a deliberate
choice — benchmark-local isolation while a parallel session owned the core
module — and each copy is separately tested. But the copies share a subtle
convention (`zeta = n·r − i n×r`, the *conjugate* of the docstring frame,
invisible for conjugation-even Dirichlet terms — the exact trap iteration 2
fell into and documented) that is currently re-explained per file.
Consolidation into one panel-quadrature helper, with the frame convention
stated once and the brute-force quadrature tests attached to it, is the
right refactor once the research surface stabilizes. *Status 2026-07-07
(review execution): deliberately deferred again — the kernel feature
surface is actively moving (log-radial features, auxiliary scales, and the
member sweep landed or are in flight this week), which is exactly the
instability the deferral condition names.*

**Duplication that mattered, now resolved: the scale gauge existed
twice.** The cross-family repair (@sec-drivaerml-crossfamily) computes
a per-sample gauge dataset-side and feeds it through the model's
*explicit* override — which meant the measure-weighted RMS radius was
implemented independently in two places: `MeshTransformer`'s built-in
intrinsic gauge and the recipe's `ComputeIntrinsicReferenceLength`
transform. Same formula, no shared code, and **no test comparing
them** — a silent divergence would have corrupted precisely the
comparison the transfer experiment rests on, since training and
evaluation reach the gauge by different routes.

Resolved by extracting one reduction
(`mesh_attention.measure_weighted_rms_radius`) that both call, with a
test pinning their agreement. Two details are deliberate rather than
tidied away:

- **The two callers pass different weights, and for this statistic it
  provably does not matter — yet.** The model weights by bare
  `cell_areas`; the dataset transform weights by
  Horvitz–Thompson-composed measures, because it estimates the
  full-resolution statistic from a subsample. Measured rather than
  asserted: a *uniform* HT factor (what ordinary random subsampling
  composes) cancels exactly between the numerator and denominator of
  both weighted means, so the two return **bitwise-identical** gauges.
  They could diverge only under non-uniform inclusion probability. The
  shared piece is therefore the reduction, not the measure — which
  costs nothing now and stays correct if non-uniform sampling arrives.
- **The float64 accumulation is defensive, not a repair.** Measured on
  realistic statistics (10k–50k cells, measures spanning $10^{-9}$ to
  $10^{-5}$), float32 already agrees to $\sim$10⁻⁸ relative — torch
  reduces pairwise. The promotion makes the gauge a function of the
  geometry rather than of the pipeline's dtype. It matters that this
  was measured rather than assumed: had the change moved the gauge
  materially, the calibration constant $C$ — fitted under the older
  code, with three retrains already run against it — would have been
  invalidated. It moves it by $\le 7\times10^{-8}$ relative, so $C$
  and those runs stand.

*Open, deferred deliberately:* the statistic is a pure mesh geometric
quantity and would sit naturally in
`physicsnemo.mesh.calculus.measure` beside `cell_measures`. It lives
in the experimental namespace instead, because promoting a symbol into
the released mesh module is a support commitment rather than a
refactor — the same class of decision as the Bessel-derivative
placement below, and Peter's to make.

**A latent contract bug, found by de-biasing the test data** *(found
during the intrinsic-gauge work, @sec-intrinsic-gauge)*. The
pair-invariant einsum took a CUDA batched-GEMM path with 1-ulp drift
that broke *bitwise* query independence for any reference length
$L \neq 1$ — invisible until then because every contract test ran on
$L = 1$ data. Found and fixed; the general lesson is the test-data
bias, not the einsum: a contract test whose fixtures all sit at a
special value of an input is a contract test with a hole in it.

**Closed during review execution (2026-07-07), kept as one line each.**
Three findings evaporated on re-reading the source — the `icosphere()`
dead assignment, orphaned `_STAR_MODES_OOD`, and unconsumed
`solid_angle_influence` — the code had already grown their consumers.
Three were fixed: `HarmonicPanelBIE` now defaults to the pruning-proved
configuration with every archived arm pinning its historical settings
explicitly (@sec-pruning); `PairInvariantFeatures` no longer computes
$\approx$ten dead floats per pair inside the dense decode when the
dictionary has no smooth member to consume them ($\approx$7% of singpair
decode wall-clock, behaviorally invisible by bitwise test); and the two
reference `MeshTransformer` numbers that differ only by bank (0.458 on
the 64-case reference bank, 0.425 on the 32-case finalist bank) now
carry explicit bank-disambiguation notes wherever they appear —
**citations should always name the bank.**

**Upstream gap worth contributing.** `torch.special.modified_bessel_k0/k1`
lack autograd derivatives; the iteration-3 custom `Function`s with analytic
recurrences ($K_0' = -K_1$, $K_1' = -K_0 - K_1/z$) are small,
nested-derivative-tested, and generally useful — a candidate for
PhysicsNeMo's utility layer or an upstream PyTorch contribution. *Status
2026-07-07 (review execution): deferred — placement is a public-API
decision (physicsnemo utility layer vs upstream PyTorch PR) that belongs
to Peter; the Functions remain tested where they live.*

## Standing caveats, restated

Everything in this book is 2D except the 3D suite and its model rows
(@sec-3d-results, @sec-3d-meshtransformer, @sec-dictionary-3d); the
harmonic Laurent basis is Laplace-specific; the parametric and pruning
ablations are seed-17-only where marked; the Neumann seeds 29/43 were stopped
mid-transit at 3,000 steps (destination established by the seed-17 10k
run); the old external baselines are under-optimized controls at 1,000
updates, superseded as evidence by the steel-manned Transolver
comparison in both regimes (@sec-transolver, @sec-transolver-dataset);
the kernel-decoder fix of @sec-kernel-decoder is three-seed confirmed on
the reference bank, and the dictionary program that followed it is
closed across 2D Laplace, screened Laplace, 3D Laplace, and Liouville
(@sec-dictionary-ablation, @sec-dictionary-3d,
@sec-singonly-universality), with one parked discriminator — whether the
nonlinear singular-only failure is representational or an optimization
instability; the single-layer-member rule of @sec-single-layer rests on
three seeds per encoder-stress family (deep-cavity closed at three,
downgrading the deep-slot failure to the singular-only arm); the
encoder-depth null of @sec-encoder-depth is two-seed on the Dirichlet
family and resolved by the mixed-BC discriminator, which itself rests
on a single mixed geometry tier with drive depth unswept
(@sec-mixed-bc); the Liouville 5,000-step oscillation is a
protocol-hygiene note, and its earlier "no best-checkpoint selection"
reading is corrected in the checked-in artifact (the val-vs-eval gap is
4-case-vs-16-case on an unstable model; @sec-liouville); the
rotational-Euler family is disk-only at three seeds (the star
generalization is declared future work, and its exact-label
certification is the family's boundary of validity;
@sec-euler-rotational); the
training histories, checkpoints, and the mode-response comparison behind
@fig-kernel, @fig-convergence, and @sec-kernel-decoder are
single-machine `/tmp` artifacts; and the cross-family transfer evidence
(@sec-drivaerml-crossfamily) is **one family pair, one reused 20-case
pilot, zero-shot only**. Transfer-v2 exists and fails, but its gauge
constant was calibrated through a loader containing held-out cases and
the same pilot informed successive hypotheses, architectures, and
diagnostics. The gauge dose-response is exploratory, not causal; raw
industrial predictions, complete configs, and checkpoint provenance are
not durably checked in. The complete audit is @sec-program-review.
